documentation.content: Runbook row: SQL availability and capacity (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Runtime observations). Responder: on-call API responder. Log-based metric sql_pool_capacity_503 (infra/monitoring/metrics/sql-pool-capacity-503.json) crossing zero occurrences in a 5-minute window; the app.operational emitter already throttles to at most one record per 60 seconds per process, so this is a useful first notification, not an exact failure counter. Initial, review after 7 days.
